text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
Source inventory: tall glazed A-frame pavilion, low base, front-left sloped glazed wing, right-front elevated terrace/canopy on posts, lower timber-clad side/rear annex, and exterior stair. The model captures the pavilion, wing, stair, and terrace, but closes the open front bay and over-articulates the annex wall.
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: The source has an open right-front terrace bay carried by square posts; the current front fills most of that span with a full-height wall beneath the fascia.
action: Recess or remove only the front-bay infill and expose the supporting posts, keeping the separate solid side annex.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="right">problem: The lower annex side is a broad, quiet timber-clad plane in the source, but the current wall is covered in dense vertical fins.
action: Replace the dense fin pattern with a broad timber surface and sparse joints, preserving the annex footprint.</issue>
<keep>Left exterior stair rising to the terrace.</keep>
<keep>Front-left glazed wing sloping down to grade.</keep>
<keep>Upper glazed gable pavilion with exposed brown framing.</keep>
